```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(depmixS4)
library(pROC)
set.seed(42)
```

We have two hidden states: **state 1 = English mode**, **state 2 =
Spanish mode**.

### π — starting language

```{r}
data <- readRDS("../Data/cs_processed.rds")
data |>
  group_by(dialogue_id, sentence_id) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(word_lang) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
pi_true <- c(0.64, 0.36) 
```

### A — switching probability

```{r}
# A[i, j] = P(next token is in state j | current token is in state i)
p_switch <- 0.018  
A_true <- matrix(c(1 - p_switch,     p_switch,
                       p_switch, 1 - p_switch),
                 nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
rownames(A_true) <- c("from eng", "from spa")
colnames(A_true) <- c("to eng",   "to spa")

cat("A =\n"); print(round(A_true, 4))

```

### B — what POS each language tends to produce

```{r}
# B[k, v] = P(POS tag = v | hidden state = k)
# Note: if B[1,] and B[2,] are very similar, POS gives no information


POS_LABELS <- c("noun", "verb", "det", "prep", "other")
V <- length(POS_LABELS)

# English POS distribution 
B_eng <- c(noun = 0.28, verb = 0.22, det = 0.18, prep = 0.14, other = 0.18)
# Spanish POS distribution 
B_spa <- c(noun = 0.30, verb = 0.26, det = 0.10, prep = 0.12, other = 0.22)

B_true <- rbind(B_eng, B_spa)
rownames(B_true) <- c("eng mode", "spa mode")

cat("B (emission probabilities):\n")
print(round(B_true, 3))
```

```{r}
data |>
  filter(!is.na(prev_y)) |>
  group_by(y, pos_fac) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = y, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  rename(eng = `0`, spa = `1`) |>
  mutate(total = eng + spa,
         frac_spa = spa / total) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(frac_spa - 0.5))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "POS distribution by language (frac_spa = proportion Spanish)")

```

## 3. Simulating sequences

```{r}
#' Returns a tibble with columns: t, state (true hidden), obs (POS index).
simulate_hmm <- function(T, pi, A, B) {
  K <- nrow(A); V <- ncol(B)
  states <- integer(T)
  obs    <- integer(T)
  states[1] <- sample(K, 1, prob = pi)
  obs[1]    <- sample(V, 1, prob = B[states[1], ])

  for (t in 2:T) {
    states[t] <- sample(K, 1, prob = A[states[t - 1], ])
    obs[t]    <- sample(V, 1, prob = B[states[t], ])
  }
  tibble(
    t      = seq_len(T),
    state  = states,
    obs    = obs,
    switch = c(0L, as.integer(diff(states) != 0))
  )
}

# Simulate 500 sentences of length 8 
SENT_LEN <- 8

sims <- map(seq_len(N_SENTS), ~ simulate_hmm(SENT_LEN, pi_true, A_true, B_true))
sim_df <- bind_rows(sims, .id = "sentence_id") |>
  mutate(sentence_id = as.integer(sentence_id),
         obs_fac = factor(obs, levels = 1:V, labels = POS_LABELS))

cat("Total tokens simulated:", nrow(sim_df), "\n")
cat("Observed switch rate:",
    round(mean(sim_df$switch[sim_df$t > 1]), 4), "\n")
cat("True switch rate (A off-diagonal):", p_switch, "\n")
```

```{r}
#ex
sample_sent <- sims[[478]]

sample_sent |>
  mutate(
    lang  = if_else(state == 1, "English", "Spanish"),
    pos   = factor(obs, levels = 1:V, labels = POS_LABELS)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(t, 1, fill = lang, label = pos)) +
  geom_tile(height = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 1), size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(English = "#2c7bb6", Spanish = "#d7191c"),
                    name = "True hidden state") +
  labs(title = "Sample simulated sentence",
       subtitle = "Tile colour = true language (hidden); text = observed POS tag",
       x = "Position t", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
```

## 4. Fitting the HMM and checking parameter recovery

```{r}
#Baum-Welch algorithm (EM)
ntimes <- rep(SENT_LEN, N_SENTS)
hmm_spec <- depmix(
  response = obs_fac ~ 1,
  data     = sim_df,
  nstates  = 2,
  family   = multinomial("identity"),
  ntimes   = ntimes
)

set.seed(42)
hmm_fit <- fit(hmm_spec,
               emcontrol = em.control(maxit = 300, tol = 1e-6),
               verbose   = FALSE)

cat("Log-likelihood:", round(logLik(hmm_fit), 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Extract estimated parameters
pi_est  <- getpars(hmm_fit)[1:2]
A_est   <- matrix(getpars(hmm_fit)[3:6], nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
K <- 2
em_off  <- 2 + K * K
B_est   <- matrix(getpars(hmm_fit)[(em_off + 1):(em_off + K * V)],
                  nrow = K, byrow = TRUE)

# EM can swap state labels — align estimated states to true states by matching
# emission distributions (whichever estimated state has higher P(det) = English)
eng_state <- which.max(B_est[, 3])   # det = column 3 (English uses more det)
spa_state <- 3 - eng_state
if (eng_state == 2) {
  pi_est <- rev(pi_est)
  A_est  <- A_est[c(2,1), c(2,1)]
  B_est  <- B_est[c(2,1), ]
}

cat("\n--- π (initial state probabilities) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("  True:      eng=%.3f  spa=%.3f\n", pi_true[1], pi_true[2]))
cat(sprintf("  Estimated: eng=%.3f  spa=%.3f\n", pi_est[1],  pi_est[2]))

cat("\n--- A (transition matrix off-diagonals = switch rates) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("  True switch rate:      %.4f\n", A_true[1, 2]))
cat(sprintf("  Estimated switch rate: %.4f\n", A_est[1, 2]))

cat("\n--- B (emission probabilities) ---\n")
comp_B <- tibble(
  POS       = POS_LABELS,
  `True eng`  = round(B_true[1,], 3),
  `Est. eng`  = round(B_est[1,],  3),
  `True spa`  = round(B_true[2,], 3),
  `Est. spa`  = round(B_est[2,],  3)
)
knitr::kable(comp_B, caption = "True vs estimated emission probabilities")
```

```{r}
tibble(
  pos       = rep(POS_LABELS, 4),
  prob      = c(B_true[1,], B_est[1,], B_true[2,], B_est[2,]),
  state     = rep(c("English mode", "Spanish mode"), each = V * 2),
  source    = rep(rep(c("True", "Estimated"), each = V), 2)
) |>
  ggplot(aes(pos, prob, fill = source, alpha = source)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ state) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(True = "grey30", Estimated = "#e08214")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(True = 0.9, Estimated = 0.7)) +
  labs(title = "Parameter recovery: true vs estimated B",
       x = "POS tag", y = "Probability", fill = NULL, alpha = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
